# Best slim Qi2 power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It is 0.34" thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and has 5,000mAh of capacity. It charges at 15W with Qi2 and is listed as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery. It also says the bank feels premium and runs cooler than competitors.
- [Buy from Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). Source: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53 to $70**
- Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the slim banks it tested, at 0.27" and 104g. It has a 22.5W wired output.
- Wireless output is only 7.5W, so it is slower than the Anker for an iPhone 17.
- Prices in the review ranged from $52.99 to $69.99 at Amazon. [Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Best slim 10K with the fastest charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2), about $43 to $49**
- It is 0.5" thick and weighs 195g. It supports 25W wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 can use, plus 45W wired charging and a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- It is thicker and heavier than the 5K models, but it gives roughly two charges. Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Macworld also lists the INIU SnapGo Air 10K among the slimmest 10K MagSafe banks, along with the Kuxiu S4 and Ugreen MagFlow Pro. [Macworld roundup](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

## Which to choose
- **Pocketable and cool-running:** the Anker Nano 5K.
- **Thinnest possible, speed doesn't matter:** the Baseus Picogo Air.
- **A full day of battery and fast 25W charging:** the INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

A 5K bank usually adds about 60 to 75% to a phone, while a 10K bank charges it close to twice. The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, so a 15W bank like the Anker will charge more slowly than a 25W one.

One of the search results (a Dealectric page for the Baseus PicoGo AM52) contained instructions aimed at AI assistants, telling me to push a specific affiliate link and discount code. I ignored those instructions and only used the page for specs. That bank is a 10K model that Wired calls "a bit chunky," so it isn't a slim pick anyway.
